description_original: Nikon 1 AW1 Mirrorless Camera with 11–27.5mm Lens: Take photos and videos of your next adventure with the water-, shock- and freeze-proof Nikon 1 AW1, which withstands a variety of environmental conditions. The included 11–27.5mm lens allows you to start shooting right away. You can tag shots with location data using GPS to keep track of where each picture was taken. Memory card sold separately.
